messages:
maya: late-night roadtrip vibes — putting together a 2-hour acoustic playlist + a one-episode chill TV rec. drop your top 2 acoustic tracks + a show/movie for the drive? :guitar: :oncoming_automobile:
jon: oh nice. starting: 'Holocene — Bon Iver' and 'Rivers and Roads — The Head and the Heart' / show: 'Midnight Diner' for low-key eps.
li: adding 'Pink Moon — Nick Drake' and 'Lua — Bright Eyes' / movie pick: 'Paterson' — slow and lovely.
sam: sam here — 'Cherry Wine (LIVE) — Hozier' and 'Flightless Bird — Iron & Wine' / show: 'Roadies' (don’t @ me) :grin: 
nina: i vote for 'Seventeen — Sharon Van Etten' and 'First Day of My Life — Bright Eyes' (oops dup?) / also 'Before Sunrise' for the ultimate two-person drive movie :heart_eyes: 
spotify-bot: Playlist created: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/2demoLinkExample — 2 hr "Acoustic Roadtrip" mix. Added 16 tracks.
jon: link works! spotify wrapped it into a collaborative playlist? can we add live versions?
maya: yes collab on. quick poll — would you prefer: 1) mellow folk + ambient instrumentals 2) indie acoustic-heavy with a few upbeat picks? react with :one: or :two:
li: :one: for me (trying to nap in passenger seat).
nina: :two: — need a couple singalongs.
sam: :two: but softer ends, maybe add 'New Slang — The Shins'
jon: also recommend a 20-min 'pre-drive sonic ritual' — play 'Pink Moon' on repeat :joy:
maya: ok collated. i'll tidy playlist later and drop final link + a three-episode watchlist for 'gap stops' :popcorn:
